name: Pumpkin Helmet

pages.text: Defeat The Scarecrow during a full moon. The equipped helmet grants Strength while the moon is full.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: The Scarecrow appears in plains during a full moon. Pumpkin minions support the fight. This encounter route is not active outside a full moon.

pages.title: How to obtain
pages.text: Defeat The Scarecrow. Its native death procedure drops one Pumpkin Helmet. There is no crafting-grid recipe. Horseless Headsman also has a separate conditional drop chance after boss progression.

pages.title: Purpose
pages.text: Equip it in the head slot. The helmet supplies 3 armor and 363 durability. During a full moon it continuously refreshes Strength at the level selected by Luminous Beasts configuration.
